Leave slips that approve themselves into the system.

  • Approval chain with reminders, never lost in a tray
  • Team calendar shows clashes before you approve

03Shift scheduling

Rotas rubbed out in pencil, rebuilt in one drag.

Plan the week once. When someone swaps, the schedule, the attendance rules and everyone's phone update together. No more photographing the wall.

  • Drag and drop rotas with clash and overtime warnings
  • Swap requests approved in a tap, both people notified
  • Shifts feed attendance, so late and overtime are automatic

04Payroll

Payslips that skip the envelope and land on every phone.

Attendance and leave flow straight into pay, so the numbers are right before you press run. Payslips go out as private PDFs the moment payroll closes.

  • Overtime, deductions and leave balances calculated from real attendance
  • One run for every employee, with an audit trail on each change
  • Payslips delivered securely, in English or Arabic
